name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Apple Fritter
description:
Sweet, warm, and bakery-fresh. The Cheech & Chong Apple Fritter D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Apple Fritter serves up that fresh-out-the-oven flavor: sweet baked apple and warm cinnamon-sugar notes up front, finished with a smooth, glazed-pastry sweetness. It's a rich, dessert-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet, cozy, and full of flavor.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Apple Fritter flavor — sweet baked apple and cinnamon sugar with a glazed finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Apple Fritter is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
